summary: Claude usage observation watches a subagents directory that appears while the session directory's watch is being set up, instead of missing every subagent transcript written in it

schema.detail: No table, file format or wire change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: After adding its directory watches, the observer looks again and watches any directory that appeared meanwhile, at most four rounds. Before, a subagents directory created between the observer's existence check and the watch on its parent raised no event, so usage from subagent transcripts in it was never recorded until the observer restarted.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back is supported; an earlier build can miss the directory again.
